lesson-intro.text: No two snowflakes are alike, but every one has six arms. Ours has a round middle, six branching arms and six tiny diamonds. Watch one arm closely, the rest are copies, then let it snow.

center.text: A snowflake grows from its middle. Draw a small circle in the center of your page.

arm-top.text: The first arm points up. Up one side, out and back for a branch, over the tip, then down the same way.

arm-upper-right.text: The next arm leans to the upper right. It is the same shape, just turned.

arm-lower-right.text: Now the lower right arm. Side, branch, tip, branch, side.

arm-bottom.text: The fourth arm points straight down, like the first one upside down.

arm-lower-left.text: Two arms to go. This one reaches to the lower left.

arm-upper-left.text: The last arm fills the gap on the upper left. Now there are six.

diamonds.text: Between the arms sit six little diamonds. Each is a tiny kite with soft corners.

arms-color.text: Color the arms and the center light blue.

lesson-outro.text: Six arms, six diamonds and one frosty middle. This snowflake will never melt.
